'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Joe Getz DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Getz]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Dark Deal
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
